component.name: Minutes
component.summary: Record meetings and transcribe them locally
Enregistrer les réunions et les transcrire localement

description.p: Minutes records your microphone and what your computer plays as two tracks, and when the meeting ends it writes the transcript, with who said what, on your own computer. No bot joins the call and no audio leaves your computer.

Minutes enregistre votre micro et ce que joue votre ordinateur sur deux pistes, et à la fin de la réunion il rédige la transcription, avec qui a dit quoi, sur votre propre ordinateur. Aucun robot ne rejoint l’appel et aucun son ne quitte votre ordinateur.
A second recording started in the same minute no longer replaces the first one's folder.

With Teams, the people speaking are named in the preview and in the transcript, and whisper is told their names. Names and words from the settings apply to the whole meeting. A quiet call is no longer taken for its end, and Cancel always works.
Two lighter versions of the usual model can be picked in the settings file.
With the Vulkan build, the speakers are found on the GPU as well: a transcript is ready about a third sooner, with the same speakers.
The live preview falls behind less after a slow passage.

The Vulkan build is now the one to use: as fast and as accurate as CUDA, with a quarter of the memory while Minutes waits in the background. Whisper runs on the dedicated GPU rather than on integrated graphics.
Problems met in the background are kept in the journal, and the top bar menu no longer fails when the screen locks.
Settings, models and recordings in progress move to folders named after Minutes, and the interface Minutes was forked from is gone.
The live preview stays as quick and as light an hour into a call as at its start.
Downloaded models are checked, meeting folders are private, and names from Teams are cleaned before they reach a transcript.
Interrupted recordings are found and recovered, and a headset that stops sending sound no longer puts the two sides out of step.
Your voice can be kept as one person, names from Teams no longer need its Participants panel open, and lines Whisper invents on silence are left out.
The preview shows what is being said as it is said, greyed, and turns it into a line once the speaker pauses.
The preview runs about four seconds behind the call, the recording stops by itself when the call ends, and names from Teams are found in the call view too.
Mute your microphone during a recording, from the window or the top bar; with Teams, Minutes follows your mute button there and names the other person in a call between two.
Minutes installs for your user and can start at login in the background, to notice calls; the microphone is only used while the window is open or a recording goes on.
A preview of the transcript is written during the call, shown in the window and in the top bar, and saved at once when the call ends; the final transcript is still made from the whole recording.
First version of Minutes: a GNOME interface on the engine of omarchy-meeting-recorder, with GPU transcription through CUDA, a glossary for names, and speakers found about a quarter faster.
